incident.title: Payments Database Failover Loop
incident.summary: Checkout degraded after a database failover introduced replication lag and repeated leader swaps.
incident.rootCause: Failover automation promoted an unhealthy replica during sustained write traffic.
actions: Add failover health gates before promotion
Block promotion when replication lag exceeds the SLO
Add runbook steps for controlled traffic reduction before database failover

timeline.title: Replication lag climbs
timeline.description: Replica lag exceeded 40 seconds after a batch settlement burst.

timeline.title: Automatic failover triggered
timeline.description: Failover automation promoted a lagging standby to primary.

timeline.title: Checkout timeouts spike
timeline.description: Checkout API exceeded the latency SLO and retried against stale database connections.

timeline.title: Traffic shed and rollback
timeline.description: Operators drained write traffic and restored the original primary.
